changes: loud_comp: report the latency of the FFT size in use and size the dry delay line for the largest FFT (the same patch as alarm-aurora's lsp-plugins-lv2 and fedora-aurora's lsp-plugins).
notes: alarm-aurora's check() also runs lsp-latency-check, an LV2 host that compares each latency port the speaker graphs use with an impulse's delay. It is not ported: it needs the target architecture to run, so a cross build could not run it.
